title: The effects of the technological setup of plastic waste pyrolysis on its environmental performance
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00182J, Paper
Open Access

Tatiana Trecáková, Aleš Paulu, Ivanna Harasymchuk, Hana Brunhoferová, Vladimír Kočí
This LCA-based study evaluates pyrolysis configurations for mixed plastic waste. The study reveals significant impact variability and highlights renewable energy integration as a key factor in optimizing environmental performance for scale-up.
